body.x: Kinsun(www.kinsun,com) introduced its connectors and antennas for medical, industrial, and telecommunication uses at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which ran Oct. 26-29 at COEX.
Displayed at TEEMA joint hall, Kinsun is a Taiwanese company that manufactures connectors, antennas, fakra, stamping, and circuit parts that are being used for many industries.
Its products have low defect rates, and they get supplied to all over the world including Samsung and LG.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
